header: The page's extended plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, at most 5 minutes with every timeout counted,
for when a longer play than the regular one (tools/play_plan.json) is needed: the launcher, Load ROM once the page has
its shader list (Chrome builds the whole list behind the launcher and says when it is done; Firefox builds none there,
and its line saying so is the one waited for), Start Game, then the title (the game's state 2, read in RDRAM) and a
Normal Championship's first three races as tools/shader_plan.json's second championship section plays them: the menus
passed by pressing until the game's state (gGameState, 0x800DAB24) says the next screen is up, a need that the first
race is on, Sunny Beach and Sunset Bay each raced 20 s with the gas held and tools/autopilot.js steering, then ended
by putting the rider on its last lap with every buoy taken, and its finish and results pressed through to the next
race, and Marine Fortress raced 15 s. A race's time is the game's own (the frame counter at 0x80151960, 20 a second):
ridden longer the autopilot misses enough buoys to be disqualified, and one disqualified sooner (state 0x29) races the
course again, which the plan takes as the next race.
load: RT64: all \d+ prebuilt shaders built|once the game draws
play: new Promise((r) => { const t0 = Date.now(), i = setInterval(() => { const s = n64r(0x800DAB24); if (s >= 2 || Date.now() - t0 > 25000) { clearInterval(i); r("state 0x" + s.toString(16)); } }, 100); })

(clearInterval(window.noRetire), window.noRetire = setInterval(() => { for (let s = 0; s < 4; s++) { const a = 0x801C2938 + s * 0x378 + 0x2E8, v = n64r(a); if (v > 0 && v < 40) n64w(a, 59); } }, 1), 0)

new Promise((r) => { const slot = n64r(0x800D48DC), a = 0x801C2938 + slot * 0x378, count = n64r(0x801BB120); n64w(a, 3); n64w(a + 0xC, 3 * count); n64w(a + 0x2F4, 1); const t0 = Date.now(), i = setInterval(() => { if (n64r(0x800DAB24) !== 0x28 || Date.now() - t0 > 10000) { clearInterval(i); r("course " + n64r(0x800D8170) + " state 0x" + n64r(0x800DAB24).toString(16)); } }, 100); })
